title: IBM Db2 Genius Hub 1.1.2, 1.1.3, 1.1.4, 1.1.5 could allow a remote authenticated attacker to obtain sensitive…
description: IBM Db2 Genius Hub versions 1.1.2 through 1.1.5 contain a vulnerability where a remote authenticated attacker could obtain sensitive information due to a missing required cryptographic step. The vulnerability has a medium severity with a CVSS score of 4.3. No patch or remediation information is currently provided.
